meta.title: Fort: Gym Workout Tracker
app.name: Fort
nav.label: Main
langPicker.label: Language
hero.title: Your gym notebook, without the noise.
hero.description: Set up your routines once, pick the one for each day and log every set as you go. Everything is saved on your phone, even without a connection.
hero.screenshotAlt: Fort logging the sets of a bench press during a chest-day workout
features.languages: Spanish, Catalan, English, French, Basque and Portuguese
steps.title: Plan. Train. Track your progress.
steps.plan.title: Plan your routine
steps.plan.description: Set up your routines once with the exercises, sets and reps you want. They'll be ready for every session.
steps.plan.imageAlt: A person in a black T-shirt checking their phone at the gym
steps.plan.screenshotAlt: Fort's new routine screen with a chest day routine and six exercises
steps.train.title: Start training
steps.train.description: Pick today's routine and log each set as you finish it. That's all you have to do.
steps.train.imageAlt: A rack of dumbbells lined up in a gym
steps.train.screenshotAlt: Fort's workout summary showing the duration, exercises and sets of a finished chest-day workout
steps.progress.title: Track your progress
steps.progress.description: Check the weights and reps of every exercise over time, and edit any past set if you need to.
steps.progress.imageAlt: Close-up of a weight stack on a gym machine
steps.progress.screenshotAlt: Fort's progress screen with a chart of the estimated one-rep max of the bench press
download.title: Start training with Fort
download.description: Fort is only available on Google Play, for Android phones.
download.screenshotAlt: Fort's progress screen with a chart of the estimated one-rep max of the bench press
